description: Verify the signed provenance envelope of memories: recomputes each content_hash and ed25519-checks the signature against THIS machine's trusted signing key (not the row's self-embedded key). Verify one by id, or a batch by scope/namespace. Returns per-memory status (verified / unsigned / tampered / untrusted) + a summary {verified, unsigned, tampered, untrusted}. "untrusted" = validly signed but by a non-trust-root key (e.g. a teammate on a synced vault) — distinct from "tampered". Read-only. Signing is enabled by MCP_SIGN_MEMORIES.

id.description: Verify a single memory by id. Omit to verify a batch by scope/namespace.

limit.description: Max memories to verify in batch mode (default 100)

namespace.description: Namespace within scope (e.g., project name, team name)

trusted_pubkeys.description: Additional trusted signer public keys (SPKI PEM) for multi-machine/team vaults — a memory signed by any of these (or by MCP_TRUSTED_PUBKEYS, or this machine's own key) verifies instead of reading 'untrusted'.

name: memory_verify
